title: Planned double-blind DNA test of the Peruvian bodies

tellings.quote: he's DNA testing it with these like independent aerospace contractors that and they're going to do some double blind stuff so no cheating allow.

plain: Small bodies from Peru that some people present as non-human were to get a DNA test in 2025 by independent aerospace contractors, set up 'double blind,' meaning those doing the test would not know which sample was which, 'so no cheating,' according to Jesse Michels. He says this himself on the show, naming Michael Mazzola and Jaime Maussan, two men connected with the bodies, and the documentary This Is Not a Hoax; if the test went as described, it would put the bodies' origin to a controlled check.
